nodes.Task: Which endoscopic intervention should be planned for Jamie Taylor?
nodes.feedback: The anatomy supports internal diversion of a communicating minor leak. A stent can be inserted without dividing the papilla, avoiding the additional sphincterotomy bleeding exposure while anticoagulation remains necessary. Papillary division can lower resistance but creates a higher-bleeding-risk intervention here. It is not interchangeable with stent diversion in this anticoagulated patient. nodes.teachingPoint: The anatomy supports internal diversion of a communicating minor leak. A stent can be inserted without dividing the papilla, avoiding the additional sphincterotomy bleeding exposure while anticoagulation remains necessary.

nodes.feedback: The sampled fluid did not represent the suspicious tissue.
